disposition_reason: Cd, Cr, Pb and Cu were measured by flame AAS in seven organs (brain, heart, lungs, liver, gizzard, kidney, flesh) of chicken, goat and cow bought in five Lahore markets; Table 1 prints mean ± SD per organ and species.

study.origin: not stated; animals aged 3-4 months (chicken), 2-3 years (goat), 3-4 years (cow)
study.market: Tollinton Market, Icchra Market, Mozang Bazar, Gulberg Main Market and Township Main Market, Lahore, Pakistan
study.method: oven-dried 105 C 1 h, HNO3/HClO4 wet digestion on hot plate, flame AAS (PerkinElmer AAnalyst 800)
study.qa: six-point calibration standards; no CRM, recovery or blanks reported

unresolved: Table 1 is labelled µg/g but the abstract and text report the same numbers as mg/g; the text compares them with ppm limits, so the table unit (µg/g = mg/kg) is used. Not rescaled.
Sample counts are unclear: methods say 'a total of 30 fresh samples', the Table 1 header says n=210 per species and n=30 per organ; n=30 per organ is recorded.
'Gizzard' is listed for goat and cow, which have no gizzard; organ identity unclear.
Table 2 values are quoted from other studies and are not findings.
Wet or dry basis is not stated (subsamples were oven-dried for 1 h before digestion).
